**Management Summary – Project LV €160,242**

The tender contains numerous specification gaps that jeopardize cost certainty and compliance. The most critical issue (high risk, €3,750) is the undefined scope and duration of site establishment, lacking concrete items (e.g., offices, storage). Medium‑risk gaps (total €15,500) affect quantity plausibility, missing layer thicknesses, material types, mortar/fill details, and mandatory thermal or water‑exposure classifications. Outdated references (DIN 1045) and absent homogen‑area data further increase geotechnical risk. Immediate actions: (1) clarify site‑setup deliverables and schedule; (2) reconcile excavation vs. disposal volumes; (3) add missing dimensions, material specs, and current normative references; (4) update all mandatory thermal, waterproofing, and ground‑condition entries. Resolving these items will secure reliable estimating and mitigate contract disputes.
